content:
👶✨ Nita Ambani’s grandchildren have names as beautiful as their legacy! From Sanskrit roots to divine meanings, each name in the Ambani family carries a special significance. Let’s take a look:

🌍 Prithvi Ambani – Son of Akash and Shloka. “Prithvi” means Earth—symbolizing stability, humility, and strength. 📚 Veda Ambani – Their newborn daughter. “Veda” means knowledge and wisdom, drawn from ancient scriptures. 💎 Adiya Piramal – Daughter of Isha and Anand. “Adiya” means a treasure gifted by God—pure and precious. 👶 Krishna Piramal – Isha and Anand’s son, named after the beloved deity, symbolizing love and mischief.

These names reflect tradition, elegance, and deep cultural roots—just like the Ambani legacy itself. 🌟
